title: 4 Cheap Accessories That Can Upgrade Your Ring Video Doorbell - BGR
summary: The $20 Ring No-Drill Mount is another inexpensive, official Ring accessory that'll speed up your doorbell install. In terms of compatibility, the mount works with numerous Ring doorbell models, including the Battery Doorbell (2026), Video Doorbell 3, and Video Doorbell (2020).
